findings.message: weigh-in could not park the call (WEIGHIN_BIN names no file: <root>/no-weighin-here): rule on it instead

proves: fan-out: the frontier has at least 3 independent tickets; park: weigh-in raised the call and deferred it with its default, and the ledger names the item; rule: the ruling was recorded
does_not_prove: that the tickets are worth running in parallel, that the call was one-way, or that the ruling or the default is right
